name: gatorlator
tagline: A browser extension that translates lecture audio live with subtitles and spoken output.

awards: Best Education, Accessibility, & Social Impact Project

problem: International students struggle with lectures and documents in a second language.
solution: Captures browser audio, translates it in real time, and plays it back as subtitles and synthetic speech.
demo_moment: Team-described: play a lecture and read translated subtitles.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Education, Accessibility, & Social Impact Project” among 112 submissions.
Built for friends who rely on chatbots to translate course material.

lessons: Live beats after-the-fact: translate while the lecture plays.
